bookTitle: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis (Anna Coulling)

facts.statement: Volume Price Analysis (VPA) is an analytical methodology combining candlestick price spread, wick shadows, and transaction volume to validate whether price moves are authentic or insider-engineered traps.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Volume Price Analysis (VPA) is an analytical methodology that uses the symbiotic relationship between price action and volume to confirm trends and spot anomalies.

facts.statement: VPA is not a modern fad but a century-old discipline established by Charles Dow, Jesse Livermore, and Richard Wyckoff, demonstrating that core human emotions of fear and greed repeat indefinitely across market eras.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: It is a 100-year-old technique utilized by market legends such as Charles Dow, Jesse Livermore, and Richard Wyckoff, who built massive fortunes using ticker tape.

facts.topic: Albert Labos & The HMS President Seminar (1998)
facts.statement: In January 1998, Anna Coulling paid £5,000 to attend Albert Labos’s two-week seminar aboard the HMS President (a 1918 anti-submarine Q-ship moored on the River Thames in London), where Labos dramatically challenged bank spies who sought to steal his insider order-flow secrets.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Two weeks later, on an early Sunday morning, I joined hundreds of other hopefuls in a packed room, on the HMS President... paying my £5,000 for a two week course.

numericalDetails.context: Cost and historical setting of Albert Labos introductory course.

facts.statement: A syndicate trader is an institutional specialist or pool operator—exemplified by partially-sighted trader Tom Williams—who executes systematic accumulation or distribution campaigns on behalf of banking cartels without triggering premature retail counter-trends.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: We were then introduced to a Tom Williams. We were told that Tom was partially sighted... and an ex syndicate trader.

facts.topic: Edwin Lefevre Reminiscences of a Stock Operator
facts.statement: Published in 1923 as a thinly-disguised biography of Jesse Livermore, Reminiscences of a Stock Operator establishes that speculation is as old as the hills, proving that ticker-tape principles govern electronic markets identically today.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: There is nothing new in Wall Street. There cannot be because speculation is as old as the hills. Whatever happens in the stock market today has happened before and will happen again.

facts.topic: Why Volume Cannot Be Hidden Invariant
facts.statement: While institutional market makers and insiders can manipulate quote prices through spread widening and false breakout spikes, volume cannot be hidden because institutional capital deployment must physically execute on the exchange tape.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Throughout the two weeks, the over-riding message was that all financial markets are manipulated in one way or another. Volume cannot be hidden. It is there for everyone to see.

facts.statement: Price spread and transaction volume are the only two leading indicators in technical finance; all derived mathematical indicators such as moving averages, stochastics, and RSI lag behind current institutional order flow.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Volume Price Analysis (VPA) is built on combining the only two leading indicators in trading: price and volume.

facts.statement: Market makers operate as commercial warehouse merchants: they accumulate inventory at wholesale discount prices during periods of extreme retail panic, then distribute inventory at retail markup prices during public euphoria.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The primary goal of a trader is to align with smart money—buying when the insiders are accumulating and selling when they are distributing.

generalAssumptions: All financial markets are systematically manipulated in some degree by institutional insiders and market makers.
Volume represents the true validation of trading effort, while price spread represents the result.
Human psychology of fear and greed remains identical across centuries and asset classes.
